title: 第26章 带不动，根本带不动
novel_title: 都重生了谁还复读？去当兵吧(酸辣榔头)
content_zh: “来来来，一排长，抽根烟压压惊！”“今回多亏了你们三班帮忙吸引火力，不然我们可就惨了！”大厕所入口，几个老兵正聚在一块抽烟。瞧见周凯东进来，赶紧掏烟出来给他点上。面对众人的献殷勤，周凯东也没拒绝，因为他正需要一根烟来解解愁。“全连那么多班，我就纳了闷了，怎么就偏偏选中我们三班？”“是啊，咱八班有长跑健将，隔壁七班有军人家庭出来的，怎么就偏偏顶盯上你们三班了？”“然后我们讨论半天，讨论出结果了......”“因为啥？”“团部领导先是在宣传栏站了一会儿，看了会儿黑板报，肯定是听说这板报是你们班陆阳出的，然后就奔着去了。”“还有，你们班丁腾飞之前泄密那事儿，团里不都知道了吗？这次估摸着下来，重点就是看看这小子有没有学好，你们班可不就成了活靶子吗？”几个老兵的分析有理有据，如此一来三班确实成了全连最扎眼的那个。但周凯东也是哑巴吃黄连，有苦说不出。因为种种原因，三班在进度上比其他班慢了一截。这也导致了在面对突击检查时，新兵发挥的极不稳定。但凡能多给他点儿时间，他保准能进步一大截，而不是像先前那样。但木已成舟，现在说啥都晚了，回头肯定又得挨连长一顿收拾批评。“一排长，说句你不爱听的，你就不该把精力浪费在不该浪费的人身上。”“你们班，那个叫陆阳的兵就挺不错，虽然底子差了点，但能吃苦，肯上进，人也机灵。”“那姓孔的小子也还行，本身有健身的底子，要是能再瘦一点就好了。”“至于那颗老鼠屎，你就放任自流好了，没必要在他身上浪费时间。”周凯东摇摇头：“有教无类，分到我们班就是我的兵，我就必须想办法把他教好。”其余人立马反驳：“话是这么说没错，但人的精力是有限的。你花更多时间去教丁腾飞，导致全班训练进度落后，这也是事实。”“因为他一个人，拖累整个班的进度，实在得不偿失。”周凯东想要反驳，但却实在不知道该说些什么。他努力去发掘丁腾飞身上的优点，但想到的全是缺点。前两天帮着去抢流动红旗这事儿，还算是有点儿讲义气。但今天这一下子，直接就给干回原形，还是在团部领导检查的时候现原形。“一排长，人得面对现实，有些生瓜蛋子不是你想捂，就能捂热的。”“你现在是关键时候，团里留四期名额本就有限，那就更得求稳。”“我们也是怕你被那小子拖累死，但凡你把精力全放在那个陆阳身上，说不定都已经出成绩了。”周凯东自然明白这个道理，陆阳是个非常积极上进的兵。任何训练，再苦再累，都会不折不扣的去完成。就连挨罚挨骂，都不会有任何抱怨。这样的兵哪怕底子薄弱，只要肯多下工夫，出成绩是迟早的事。反观丁腾飞，这小子明明和陆阳是老乡，但却完全是两个极端。懒惰，抱怨，懒惰，经常好了伤疤忘了疼。属于你拽着他，他还往下赖，死活不肯走的那种。但这个兵本质并不坏，只是比较蠢，再加上过去的经历，导致他性格上的叛逆。所以周凯东才想试着拉一把，看看能不能把这小子从离经叛道的路上拽回来，不然在部队混两年出去，依旧是个祸害。到那时，他祸害的可就不止是他自已，甚至会丢了军人的脸面，这是周凯东绝对无法容忍的。而对于他的执着，旁人也是十分无语，更有熟悉的他直接骂了一声倔驴。“真是不撞南墙不回头！你信不信，这小子最多消停两三天，还得惹事？”“赌什么？”“两包小苏。”“好！”周凯东也是嘴硬，但心里其实也没底。只能期望，这小子能学点儿好。哪怕只学到陆阳的一半，也足够了。……“吃饭之前，讲一下！”第二天清晨，食堂台阶前。连长高峰冷冷的冲着刚吊过嗓子的新兵说道。“昨天，团部领导在操课时间，来了一次突击检查。结果可以说是，一塌糊涂。”“在这，我就不具体点名是某个班了；但极个别滥竽充数，狗改不了吃屎的家伙，给我注意点！”光听前面这段，大家可能还不知道在说谁。但提到狗改不了吃屎，三班新兵立马明白暗指丁腾飞。陆阳用余光瞥了一眼，果然丁腾飞的表情，跟吃了苍蝇似的。都知道是谁，那是不是点名道姓，也就没意义了。队伍里的丁腾飞捏紧拳头，心里要多憋屈有多憋屈。原本他以为跑了全班三公里第一，就能得到表扬夸奖，就能像陆阳那样受到关注。却没想到，等来的却是食堂门口的公开处刑，甚至当着全连的面被骂的那么难听。班长周凯东同样苦着张脸，从昨晚点名前的工作汇报，到先前开晨会，他已经被连长和指导员先前喷成筛子。甚至于连长都放狠话，说他要是再带不好，再干不出成绩，就让他滚回老部队，换个人来当这个三班班长。现在，他也属于是泥菩萨过河，自身难保......高峰背着手，冷哼一声：“所以从今天起，我决定早中晚各一遍三公里。也就是说，每人每天都得给我跑到九公里！”救命啊！要死了！这跟上刑场有啥区别？他们才只是新兵啊，这么大训练量，怕是老兵都不一定吃得消！这下子，三班再次成为众矢之的，被其他班狠狠的埋怨上。更有甚者，已经偷偷在心里骂开，无差别的问候三班所有人。陆阳心里也是十分无奈，新兵连属于参军入门级，顶多就是青铜段位。他原以为靠着系统，再加上自身努力，肯定能混得风生水起。结果没想到上来就匹配了个猪队友，把把天坑。带不动，根本带不动……
content_en: "Come on, come on, we're all in a row, let's have a cigarette to calm down the panic!" "Thanks to your third class this time for helping to draw the firepower, otherwise we would be in trouble!" At the entrance of the large toilet, several veterans were gathering together to smoke.Seeing Zhou Kaidong come in, he quickly took out a cigarette and lit it for him.Faced with everyone's attentiveness, Zhou Kaidong did not refuse, because he just needed a cigarette to relieve his worries."There are so many classes in the company, so I was confused. Why did our third class just get selected?" "Yes, our eighth class has long-distance runners, and the seventh class next door has military families, so why did we focus on your third class?" "Then we discussed for a long time, and the results came out..." "Why?" "The regiment leader first stood at the bulletin board for a while and read the blackboard report., I must have heard that this blackboard was published by Lu Yang of your class, and then he ran away." "Also, didn't everyone in the regiment know about the leak of the secret by your squadmate Teng Fei?The key point this time is to see if this kid has learned well, won't your class become a living target?" The analysis of several veterans is reasonable, and in this way, the third class has indeed become the most eye-catching one in the company.But Zhou Kaidong is also a mute who eats Coptis chinensis and cannot express his pain.Due to various reasons, the progress of class three is slower than that of other classes.This also led to the extremely unstable performance of the recruits when facing surprise inspections.As long as he is given a little more time, he will definitely improve a lot, instead of being like before.But the deal is done, it's too late to say anything now, and I will definitely have to be criticized by the company commander again later."First platoon leader, if you don't like to hear something, you shouldn't waste your energy on people you shouldn't waste." "The soldier named Lu Yang in your class is quite good. Although his background is a bit poor, he can endure hardships, is willing to make progress, and is a good person."Smart." "The boy named Kong is okay.He has a good foundation for fitness.It would be better if he could lose weight." "As for that rat, just let him go.There is no need to waste time on him."Dong shook his head: "There is no distinction between teachers and teachers. If he is assigned to our class, he will be my soldier. I must find a way to teach him well." The others immediately retorted: "That is true, but people's energy is limited. It is also true that you spend more time teaching Ding Tengfei, causing the whole class's training progress to fall behind." "Because he is dragging down the progress of the entire class by himself, it is really not worth the gain." Zhou Kaidong wanted to refute, but really didn't know what to say.He tried hard to discover the advantages in Ding Tengfei, but all he thought of were his shortcomings.Helping to grab mobile red flags two days ago was a bit of a sign of loyalty.But today, all of a sudden, I went back to my original shape, and I still showed my original shape during the inspection by the regiment leader."As a platoon leader, you have to face reality. There are some raw melons and eggs that you can't just cover up if you want to." "You are at a critical moment now. The number of places in the regiment for the fourth period is limited, so you need to be more stable." "We are also afraid that you will be dragged to death by that kid. As long as you put all your energy on Lu Yang, you may have achieved results." Zhou Kaidong naturally understands this truth. Lu Yang is a very motivated soldier.Any training, no matter how hard or tiring it is, will be completed without compromise.Even if he was punished or scolded, there would be no complaints.Even if such a soldier has a weak foundation, as long as he is willing to put in more effort, it will be a matter of time before he achieves results.On the other hand, Ding Tengfei, this guy and Lu Yang are obviously from the same hometown, but they are completely opposite.Lazy, complaining, laziness, the scars are often healed and the pain is forgotten.It's the kind of person who keeps clinging to you even if you drag him, and refuses to leave.But this soldier is not bad in nature, he is just stupid. Coupled with his past experiences, he has a rebellious character.That's why Zhou Kaidong wanted to try to pull him back from his deviant ways. Otherwise, he would still be a scourge after spending two years in the army.By then, he will not only harm himself, but will even lose the face of the soldiers. This is something Zhou Kaidong will never tolerate.As for his persistence, others were speechless, and those who were more familiar with him directly scolded him for being a stubborn donkey."You really won't look back until you hit the wall! Believe it or not, this kid can only stay quiet for two or three days at most and still cause trouble?" "What are you betting on?" "Two packets of Xiaosu." "Okay!" Zhou Kaidong also said something tough, but he actually didn't know what he was doing.We can only hope that this kid can learn a little better.Even if you only learn half of what Lu Yang did, it would be enough...."Let me talk before eating!" Early the next morning, in front of the steps of the cafeteria.Company Commander Gao Feng said coldly to the recruits who had just raised their throats."Yesterday, the leaders of the regiment came for a surprise inspection during class time. The result can be said to be a complete mess." "Here, I will not specifically name a certain class; but there are a few people who are just pretending to be fake, and dogs can't change the shit-eating guys, please pay attention to me!" Just listen to the previous paragraph, you may not know who you are talking about.But when it comes to dogs eating shit, the recruits in the third class immediately understood that it was alluding to Ding Tengfei.Lu Yang glanced at him out of the corner of his eye, and sure enough, Ding Tengfei's expression looked like he had eaten a fly.Everyone knows who it is, so there is no point in naming them.Ding Tengfei in the team clenched his fists, feeling as frustrated as he could.Originally, he thought that if he ran first in the three-kilometer class, he would be praised and praised, and he would receive the same attention as Lu Yang.Unexpectedly, what awaited him was a public execution at the entrance of the cafeteria, and he was even scolded so unpleasantly in front of the entire company.Squad leader Zhou Kaidong also had a grimace on his face. From the work report before roll call last night to the previous morning meeting, he had been sprayed by the company commander and instructor.Even the company commander made harsh words, saying that if he continued to lead poorly and failed to achieve results, he would be asked to go back to the old army and replace him with someone else as the third squad leader.Now, he is also a clay Buddha crossing the river, and he cannot save himself... Gao Feng clasped his hands behind his back and snorted coldly: "So starting from today, I decided to run three kilometers in the morning, noon and evening. In other words, everyone has to run nine kilometers for me every day!" Help!Dying!How is this different from the execution ground?They are just new recruits. With such a large amount of training, even veterans may not be able to handle it!Now, Class 3 once again became the target of public criticism and was severely complained by other classes.What's more, he has secretly cursed in his heart and greeted everyone in the third class indiscriminately.Lu Yang was also very helpless. The recruit company belonged to the entry level of joining the army, at most the bronze rank.He originally thought that relying on the system and his own efforts, he would be able to prosper.As a result, I didn't expect to be matched with a pig teammate when I came up, and it was a mess.I can't carry it, I can't carry it at all...
